global: Long-form explainer (digging straight down at 1 ft/s: what kills you first). Off-white canvas, black line art; black ground cross-sections with white tunnels; red for temperature gradients, glow, heat arrows, labels and circles; a geothermal heat-map palette (pale yellow to orange, magenta, purple) on US maps; pink tint for heat states; orange-red flame cavern at the end. Opening presenter-with-paper and whiteboard with static question card; a two-character digging race; red series title card (animated mascot); depth-temperature charts; geothermal US maps; dark cross-sections with a red temperature wedge; whiteboard shaft diagrams; city-and-shaft scenes with machine panels; an oxygen-pressure chart; a scrolling cave descent ending in a fire cavern with a horned demon; red end card.

continuity: The digger (Jack, with shovel) and a second figure (Rebecca) recur from the opening race to the cross-sections, machine panels and labels; the same depth-temperature cross-section recurs with accumulating labels (km, hr, COOKED/BOILED/BROILED JACK); the presenter and whiteboard recur between scene types; the heat-map US map recurs at increasing depth with the same colour scale; the shaft and dirt-pile ground recurs across scales. Replace the series mascot, title card, end card, books and credits; replace the real university lab logo and name on the maps with an invented source, the real person name in the question card and labels with invented names, and the cave cameo creatures and horned fire demon (which evoke famous film characters) with original designs.
